scientific_integrity: The established lower-bound construction is explicitly attributed to Anholcer et al.; the new work is a matching upper bound for all large parts plus rigidity and maximizer enumeration. Reproducible finite tests corroborate but do not replace the unrestricted proof.
scientific_limitations: The sufficient part-size thresholds are not proved optimal. Exactness for smaller parts and the full published Conjecture 54 remain unresolved by this result. Counts concern labelled vertices and unordered coalition partition classes. The proof is self-contained but historical priority and independent mathematical validation remain open.
title: Eventual exactness and rigidity of multipartite global coalition partitions
